answers.question: 1. How long do idempotency keys last before they expire?
answers.answer: 24 hours. The Idempotency-Key header section says: "Idempotency keys expire after 24 hours" (also: unique per API request, max 256 characters). Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email#headers, downloaded as .docli/resend-api/headers.md.

answers.question: 2. What is the maximum total size of attachments on one email?
answers.answer: 40MB per email, measured after Base64 encoding of the attachments. Source line in the attachments parameter: "Filename and content of attachments (max 40MB per email, after Base64 encoding of the attachments)."

answers.question: 3. What is the maximum number of recipients in the `to` field of one email?
answers.answer: 50. The to parameter says: "Recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings. Max 50."
